# Conversational Analysis {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

Just ask

## Questions, Not Formulas {auto-animate=true}

Upload `expenses_export.csv` and ask:

::: {.incremental}
- *"What is our **fastest-growing** expense category?"*
- *"Summarize the spending **trends** for Q3 vs. Q2."*
- *"Which **vendor** did we spend the most with — and on what?"*
- *"Flag any expense that looks like a **duplicate** or an outlier."*
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-tip}
## The skill is the question
A precise question gets a precise answer. Vague in, vague out.
:::

# Extract & Enrich {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

From a photo to a row

## Read a Receipt, Reconcile It {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="ocr" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
Hand the agent a **receipt image** → it pulls out vendor, date, amount, VAT (**OCR**) →
then **reconciles** it against the expense export.
:::

. . .

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
*"Does this receipt match a row in the file? If not, add it."*
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## Verify the numbers
A great moment for **double-check** (the advanced moves) — totals are expensive to get wrong.
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-tip}
## Behind the scenes: a script
For exact math like this, the agent **writes and runs a script** — the same scripts you met
in the Skills session. It computes; it doesn't estimate. You still never see the code.
:::

# "What If" Scenarios {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

Model the change, then ask

## Plan on the Enriched Data {auto-animate=true}

::: {.incremental}
- *"If we **cut Travel by 20%**, what's the new monthly total?"*
- *"What's the VAT impact if **Meals** doubles next quarter?"*
- *"Which **two categories** would I trim to save 10,000 SAR?"*
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-warning}
## Newspaper Test still applies
Real financials? **Sanitize** or use the **sandbox** dataset before uploading.
:::

# Micro-Check {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

Conversational command structures

## Quiz {auto-animate=true}

Which question will get the **most useful** answer?

. . .

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**A)** "Tell me about the expenses."

❌ Too vague — you'll get a shrug.
:::
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**B)** "Top 3 categories by total spend, with the % each is of the month."

✅ Specific metric, grouping, and format.
:::
:::
:::
::::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Interview, don't formula** — upload the file and ask in plain language
2. **Precise questions win** — name the metric, the grouping, the format
3. **Extract & enrich** — OCR a receipt, then reconcile against the data
4. **"What if" on the spot** — model budget changes conversationally
5. **Verify & sanitize** — double-check the numbers; mind the Newspaper Test
:::
